message:
release: 0.2.156 (PC) and APK 0.2.28 -- the host's own exit lines reach the NAS; PC keys are reachable from the phone keyboard

hostapp-log-upload (t-6xmm1z87, ..798bfca): GNLinkHost logs the streaming child's exit (code incl. NTSTATUS, pid, ranMs,
restart planned or not, local dump path, last child line sanitised -- any line with a credential marker is redacted whole)
and its [host-app] lines now upload on the host stream, so a silent GNLinkStream death (Home PC 10-11 01:31) is visible on
the NAS. apk-keyboard-tabs (t-w3r0jdl2, f7079c0): [휴대폰 자판 | PC 키] tabs above the keyboard; PC keys reachable with no
IME showing; landscape key labels whole (rail beside the column); a phone goes back upright on leaving the viewer.
Verified: Codex SOURCE OK on both; verifier's independent builds (host_app_log 38/0, log_upload PASS, host_exit_upload 13/0;
APK unit 177/0, APK entries equal to the worker's but for source paths/synthetic lambda checksums); main integration
5ea2cc6 30/30 exit0 (host e2e with opt-in) + Android unit 177/0.
Not verified: a real phone/tablet, Samsung keyboard, a hardware keyboard; a real GNLinkStream crash reaching the NAS.

Product: version only (PC 0.2.155 -> 0.2.156; APK 0.2.27 -> 0.2.28, versionCode 26 -> 27). Test: none. Docs: none.
